SEARCH
Package controllers

Class Client_Controller

java.lang.Object
controllers.Client_Controller
All Implemented Interfaces:
ChatIF
public class Client_Controller extends Object implements ChatIF
The main controller for the client-side application. It manages the network connection to the server and routes incoming responses to the appropriate GUI screens using a Handler Map pattern.
